findings.title: runPty failure message lacks step title
findings.problem: Spec's Approach section names both runExternalWindow and runPty for the failure-message improvement, but only runExternalWindow was updated in this diff; runPty's success/catch branches still emit 'Did not complete (exit N)' / 'Failed to open terminal: ...' with no step title.
findings.impact: On the macOS path for 2.3.3/2.3.5 (and runExternalWindow's own analogous catch-adjacent runPty usage), a failed step still gives no indication of which step failed, which is the exact gap AC4 exists to close.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with the task owner whether runPty is in scope for this ticket. If yes, prefix runPty's failure messages with ctx.step.title to match runExternalWindow's format; if genuinely out of scope, narrow AC4/spec wording to runExternalWindow only.
